statement: Let Ei/Fi be solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields. Every isomorphism θ : Gal(E1/F1) ∼ − → Gal(E2/F2) is induced by a unique field isomorphism j : E2 ∼ − → E1, with gj = jθ(g) for all g.
